messages:
Aisha: Heads up — ACME wants a VPC-onprem setup where traffic to model pods goes via a field relay in their DMZ. They require tenant IP preservation, no egress changes, and optional airgap installer. Need rough launch criteria + cost delta estimate. Thoughts?
Connor: @Aisha ok — two quick Qs: 1) Are we mandatory to preserve client source IPs (LB vs SNAT)? 2) Expected QPS per tenant? We need to pick relay vs sidecar cost tradeoffs.
Aisha: They want source IP preserved for auditing, so no SNAT if possible. QPS is low per tenant (~5–20 rps) but many tenants (hundreds).
Katie: Installer footprint: sidecar adds ops complexity. Relay approach means extra network hop but keeps install smaller. Need perf numbers: latency add per hop and bandwidth.
Maria: Field ops flagged that customers can't open inbound ports to control plane. Relay must be outbound from customer to us or be fully customer-hosted. Airgapped customers need operator bundle.
Dan: Proposal: two patterns
- Relay-as-service (outbound tunnel to customer relay agent) — minimal install, easier upgrades
- Tenant-side relay (customer-managed, runs in their VPC) — zero egress policy changes, more support
We should define canary: 10 customers on relay-as-service, 3 on tenant-side, run for 4 weeks.
Connor: +1. Need to surface SLOs: 99th latency target + fallback path. If relay fails we should fallback to model-light variant (smaller context) to reduce resource needs.
Jen: Launch criteria ideas:
- Installer supports offline mode (airgap) with KMS integration tested
- BGP/peering docs + tenant network checklist
- Telemetry: token-level cost visible per-tenant
- Successful canary with <2% error uplift and <50ms p90 added latency
If we hit those, ship GA.
Aisha: Also need pricing notes — relay-as-service adds per-tenant egress cost. Rough guess: $X/month per tenant for outbound tunnel plus compute amortization.
Connor: Action items
- Connor: perf benchmark relay vs sidecar (latency, CPU)
- Katie: installer min-footprint spec + airgap packaging
- Maria: netops checklist and peering playbook draft
- Dan: rollout plan + canary gating
- Jen: compose launch criteria doc and pricing delta
All: please ack by EOD so we can sync with sales next week :calendar: 
katie: ack
dan: ack :thumbsup:
maria: ack
connor: ack
Jen: ack
deploy-bot: deploy status: nightly-relay-bench v3 started — logs: https://ci.internal/relays/1754209876
Aisha: thanks everyone. I'll collate into a PR for the roadmap after ack.
